doc:
Whether the "Hungarian prefix" lint requires type prefixes on
parameters and local/script variables (`allow`) or flags those
prefixes (`forbid`). The lint itself is off unless
`rules.hungarian_prefix` is set; this only selects which way it
points. See [`Hungarian`]. Arguments always take a leading `a`
(`ab`/`ai`/`af`/`as`/`ak`); `ai` is argument integer, not an
engine-only prefix.

schema.description: Whether the Hungarian-prefix lint requires type prefixes (allow) or flags them (forbid). The rule itself stays off unless rules.hungarian_prefix is enabled.
